source.author: ov
source.text: Quae radio stantis percurrens stamina telae vulgatos taceo dixit pastoris amores Daphnidis Idaei, quem nymphe paelicis ira contulit in saxum tantus dolor urit amantes.
source.text_original: Quae radio stantis percurrens stamina telae / 'vulgatos taceo' dixit 'pastoris amores / Daphnidis Idaei, quem nymphe paelicis ira / contulit in saxum (tantus dolor urit amantes).
source.text_english: She ran through the threads of the standing loom with her shuttle and told, I pass over the familiar loves of the shepherd Daphnis of Ida, whom the rage of a jealous nymph turned to stone; so great a grief burns lovers.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nee vellera tantum indignanda manent propiorque ex virgine rapta ille dolor, sed nulla magis sententia menti fixa meae: veniet Phrygia nam pastor ab Ida, qui gemitus irasque pares et mutua Grais dona ferat.
reuse.text_original: nee vellera tantum / indignanda manent propiorque ex virgine rapta / ille dolor, sed nulla magis sententia menti / fixa meae: veniet Phrygia nam pastor ab Ida, / qui gemitus irasque pares et mutua Grais / dona ferat.
reuse.text_english: Not only do the fleeces remain deserving of indignation, and that pain, closer to me, from the virgin who was ravished; but no thought is more firmly fixed in my mind: for the shepherd will come from Phrygian Ida, who will bring to the Greeks groans and wrath in equal measure, and gifts in return.
